subject: HealthSync procurement + security clearance — onboarding checklist & timeline
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@healthsync.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.s@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: HealthSync procurement & security checklist + next steps

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep the pilot on track for mid‑March: 

Call highlights (brief):
- Use case: 2 internal teams (Clinical Insights, Patient Messaging) for automated summarization and template responses.
- Target pilot: 5k monthly users, 1k concurrent requests at peak.
- Priority constraints: data residency (US), strict audit trail, SOC 2 evidence required.

Open items we promised to send:
1) Redwood SOC 2 summary + DPA (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
2) vendor onboarding questionnaire we typically fill for procurement (attached: vendor-onboarding-questions.xlsx).
3) sample SOW template you can drop into your procurement system (we'll attach that after you confirm PO routing).

Procurement questions for your team (can you confirm):
- Who is the economic buyer who will sign the PO? (we understood this may be Priya but want to confirm officially)
- Where should we send invoices (email for AP) and what is preferred payment term (Net 30/45)?
- Do you require a Purchase Order number prior to invoicing?

Security/legal questions: 
- Who will own the security questionnaire and what is a realistic timeline for completion?
- Do you require an in‑scope security architecture diagram or a short data flow document?

Proposed near term timeline:
- This week: you confirm the econ buyer / AP contact and mileposts.
- By Feb 12: we share completed SOC 2 summary + DPA + SOW draft for PO.
- Week of Feb 22: procurement/legal review.
- Week of Mar 15: pilot kickoff (subject to PO + security clearance).

If that all looks right, can we book a 30‑minute alignment call with procurement & security on your side? I included Marissa (on our Finance ops) and Karthik (technical lead) on the thread so they can join.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555‑0118
attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, vendor-onboarding-questions.xlsx
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@healthsync.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthSync procurement & security checklist + next steps

Thanks Tessa — useful recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Economic buyer: confirmed — Priya Sethi (our CFO) will be signatory for any commitments > $50k.
- AP routing: please send invoice to ap@healthsync.com and include PO number; payments are Net 45.
- PO requirement: yes, we need a PO number before payment. Procurement will issue one after Legal signs the MSA.

Security contacts: Marco Liu (cc'd on this reply) is our Security Engineering lead and will coordinate the questionnaire. Marco, can you confirm expected turnaround for the standard vendor questionnaire?

Pilot timing: Mar 15 looks good in principle. Two caveats: legal review windows are tight the week of Feb 22 and procurement sometimes takes 10 business days. We'll prioritize but please expect some back-and-forth.

Oliver
Director of Product Operations
HealthSync

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes from Finance/ops to make the PO flow smoother: 

Action items for HealthSync procurement team (please confirm owners):
- Confirm PO template and whether HealthSync will route the PO via Ariba or via an internal PO number (reply with preferred workflow).
- Confirm billing contact name & address for remittance (we will put that on the invoice).
- Confirm tax form requirements (W‑9 or W‑8 if applicable).

A couple suggestions from our side to avoid invoice delays:
- When you issue the PO, please include the job/engagement code and the pilot start/end dates.
- Send PO pdf to AP and cc marissa.cole@redwood.com so we can match on receipt and expedite processing.

Attachments I will share if useful: sample-sow-template.docx (we can prefill for the pilot and attach to the PO).

Marissa Cole
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthSync procurement & security checklist + next steps

Marco / Oliver —

Quick technical clarifications from engineering so we can scope the security artifacts: 

1) Data flows: For the pilot, we will process patient identifiers in a tokenized form. We can provide a one‑page data flow and a short architecture diagram showing regions (US‑West). Would that suffice for your review?
2) Hosting: Redwood Hosted API will run in the US region; if you need a VPC/private deployment we can discuss Dedicated slots but that will change billing cadence.
3) Questionnaire: we can complete your vendor security questionnaire or provide our standard security pack (SOC2 summary, penetration test high level, incident response plan). What format is easiest for you?

Timing: if Marco can share the questionnaire by EOD Tue (your time), we can return completed pack within 3 business days.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

3) Redwood: we will share a prefilled SOW draft and the SOC2 + DPA documents by tomorrow (Feb 10).
